# Thanksgiving Hymns Column 13 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** 1QHa (Cave 1), Col. 13 | **Condition:** moderately well preserved

---

**13:1** When all the arrows of the pit fly without return and are loosed without hope;

**13:2** when the measuring line falls upon judgment and the lot of anger upon the abandoned,

**13:3** and the outpouring of fury upon the hidden ones, and the time of wrath upon all Belial;

**13:4** and the cords of death surround without escape, and the torrents of Belial overflow all the high banks.

**13:5** Like a fire that eats into all their channels, consuming every green and dry tree from their streams,

**13:6** and it lashes with tongues of flame until all who drink from them are no more.

**13:7** It eats into the foundations of clay and the expanse of the dry land;

**13:8** the foundations of the mountains are given over to burning, and the roots of flint become torrents of pitch.

**13:9** And it devours down to the great abyss, and the torrents of Belial break through to Abaddon,

**13:10** and the creatures of the abyss roar amid the tumult of those churning the mud.

**13:11** And the earth cries out because of the calamity that has come upon the world, and all its creatures shriek,

**13:12** and all who are upon it go mad, and they totter in the great calamity.

**13:13** For God thunders with the roar of His strength, and His holy dwelling resounds with His glorious truth,

**13:14** and the host of heaven gives forth its voice, and the eternal foundations melt and shake,

**13:15** and the war of the mighty ones of heaven sweeps through the world and does not turn back

**13:16** until the full completion that is decreed forever, and there is nothing like it.

**13:17** I thank You, O Lord, for You have redeemed my soul from the pit,

**13:18** and from Sheol-Abaddon You have raised me up to an eternal height.

**13:19** And I walk about on a limitless plain, and I know that there is hope

**13:20** for the one whom You have formed from dust for the eternal council.

**13:21** You have purified the perverse spirit from great transgression to stand in the station

**13:22** with the host of the holy ones and to enter into community with the congregation of the sons of heaven.

**13:23** And You have cast for a man an eternal lot with the spirits of knowledge,

**13:24** to praise Your name in the community of jubilation and to recount Your wonders before all Your works.

**13:25** And I, a creature of clay, what have I spoken that was not previously planned,

**13:26** and what can I devise that has not been thought before? Everything is inscribed before You

**13:27** with the stylus of remembrance for all the appointed times of eternity,

**13:28** and for the numbered cycles of the years of the world in all their appointed seasons,

**13:29** and they shall not be hidden, and not one of them shall be lacking from before You.

**13:30** How shall a man reckon up his sin? And how shall he plead concerning his iniquities?

**13:31** And how shall he give answer to every righteous judgment? To You, O God of knowledge, belong

**13:32** all the works of righteousness and the counsel of truth. But to the sons of men belongs

**13:33** the service of iniquity and the deeds of deceit.

**13:34** You have created breath for the tongue, and You know its words and You have established the fruit of the lips

**13:35** before they were. You set words upon a measuring line and the utterance of the breath of the lips by measure.

**13:36** You bring forth the lines according to their secrets and the utterances of breath according to their reckoning,

**13:37** to make known Your glory and to recount Your wonders in all Your works of truth and Your righteous judgments.

---
*EMET notes: Column 13 opens with a vivid apocalyptic battle scene before transitioning to thanksgiving and meditation on human limitation. The fire-and-flood imagery in lines 4-10 is among the most intense in the Hodayot. "Torrents of Belial" (nachalei Beliyya'al) echoes Psalm 18:5. "Stylus of remembrance" -- God's pre-inscribed plan for all history.*
